methods.name: Daddy's Home, then starter furniture
methods.note: Miniquest takes you to 8 and gives supplies. Then chairs, bookcases and larders, oak from 15, carved oak tables to 33.

methods.name: Mahogany Homes
methods.note: Contracts in four cities. Far more XP per plank and less clicking. A plank sack lifts expert contracts to about 260,000.

methods.name: Shipwright hull parts
methods.note: Workbench by a bank, about 1,000 parts an hour. Half the XP per plank but the parts sell or feed Sailing. Relaxed pace.

methods.name: Fishing crane repair
methods.note: Port Piscarilius. Each repair gives 4x your level in Construction and Crafting for 3 planks and nails. Slow but very cheap.

methods.name: Oak larders
methods.note: Eight oak planks, 480 XP each. About 485,000 an hour from 50 with a demon butler. The cheap standard route to 74.

methods.name: Mounted mythical capes
methods.note: Three teak planks and the cape for 370 XP. Best XP per teak plank. Up to 430,000 an hour at maximum efficiency.

methods.name: Mahogany tables
methods.note: Six mahogany planks, 840 XP each with a demon butler. Up to about 900,000 an hour. Fastest until gnome benches at 77.

methods.name: Teak garden benches
methods.note: Fastest use of teak planks, 540 XP each in the superior garden. Needs precise timing. 700,000 with perfect execution.

methods.name: Oak dungeon doors
methods.note: Ten oak planks, 600 XP each. Cheaper and less click-intensive than mahogany or teak. Up to 550,000 at maximum efficiency.

methods.name: Gnome benches
methods.note: Two adjacent hotspots in the superior garden with mahogany planks. Best rate in the game at just over 1,100,000 an hour.

unverified: Daddy's Home, then starter furniture: no hourly rate in either guide for levels 1-33 furniture (xph 0)
Oak larders: the guide gives no rate below level 50 (xph at 33 is 0). The band at 50 is the midpoint of the stated 480,000-490,000 'with some mistakes'
Fishing crane repair: the guide gives XP per repair (4 x level) and a 30-60 second break interval but no XP per hour (xph 0)
Mahogany Homes: bands are midpoints of the no-plank-sack ranges. Plank-sack ranges are 50-70k, 110-140k, 155-200k, 240-280k
Oak dungeon doors and gnome benches are not named in the Ironman Guide. Marked 'both' because that guide says ironman Construction is 'not very different' from normal training once planks are sourced
Shipwright hull parts: rates assume about 1,000 parts an hour at the Deepfin Point workbench. Camphor, ironwood and rosewood tiers need Sailing-era planks
Shipwright hull parts: the guide lists ironwood hull parts at level 77, but the Ironwood hull parts page (fetched live) says 75 since the 22 July 2026 update. Band uses 75
Daddy's Home: the main guide says 944 XP in total, the Ironman Guide says the reward is 544 XP
Mounted mythical capes: the main guide says level 50 (Dragon Slayer II needs 50 Construction), the Ironman Guide heading says 47. lv uses 50
